annotation.title_clean: ASTM F3218-17 Standard Practice for Recording Environmental Effects for Utilization with A-UGV Test Methods
annotation.title_en: ASTM F3218-17 Standard Practice for Recording Environmental Effects for Utilization with A-UGV Test Methods
annotation.venue: ASTM International Book of Standards Vol. 15.13
annotation.summary_en: ASTM F3218-17 is a voluntary standard practice for recording environmental conditions (lighting, sensor emissions, temperature, humidity, electrical interference, ground surface, air quality) affecting automated unmanned ground vehicles, enabling comparable performance test results. Page is an ASTM store listing with excerpted content.
key_provisions_or_claims: Defines parameterized levels for lighting, temperature, humidity, ground surface and air quality conditions
Requires recording external sensor emitter type, number and location
Provides a basis for comparing A-UGV performance across test methods
References EMC standards such as EN 12895 and IEC 61000
Developed under WTO TBT principles for international standards
